modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.desc: Shared config values powered by Fzzy Config.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.fall: Bare double example from the Fzzy docs. It serializes, but it is not validated and does not generate a config widget.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.logC: Write the currently loaded config values during common mod initialization.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.welc: Example synced text value stored in the shared config.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.star: Validated integer example with bounded values for a simple retry budget.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.aler: Validated double example using a bounded 0.0 to 1.0 slider range.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.broa: Validated choice example with a small fixed set of allowed string values.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.sync: Validated enum example for cycling through a few preset behaviors.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.feat: Validated identifier example using a Minecraft item id.
modernminecraftmodtemplate.settings.game: Nested config section example that groups related settings into a sub-screen.
Nested boolean example inside a ConfigSection.
Nested validated integer example inside a ConfigSection.
Nested validated string example inside a ConfigSection.
